name: Test - Companion VDM harvest
bpmnXml:
<bpmn2:definitions xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:bpmn2="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="sample-diagram" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL BPMN20.xsd">
  <bpmn2:process id="Process_1" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn2:startEvent id="start" name="Start manually">
      <bpmn2:outgoing>start_buildOrder</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:startEvent>
    <bpmn2:scriptTask id="buildOrder" name="Build sample order">
      <bpmn2:incoming>start_buildOrder</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>buildOrder_mapOrder</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:scriptTask>
    <bpmn2:businessRuleTask id="mapOrder" name="Map order to CRM deal">
      <bpmn2:incoming>buildOrder_mapOrder</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>mapOrder_returnDeal</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:businessRuleTask>
    <bpmn2:endEvent id="returnDeal" name="Return mapped deal">
      <bpmn2:incoming>mapOrder_returnDeal</bpmn2:incoming>
    </bpmn2:endEvent>
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="start_buildOrder" sourceRef="start" targetRef="buildOrder" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="buildOrder_mapOrder" sourceRef="buildOrder" targetRef="mapOrder" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="mapOrder_returnDeal" sourceRef="mapOrder" targetRef="returnDeal" />
  </bpmn2:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_1">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_1" bpmnElement="Process_1">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="start_di" bpmnElement="start">
        <dc:Bounds x="412" y="262" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="385" y="312" width="90" height="20" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="buildOrder_di" bpmnElement="buildOrder">
        <dc:Bounds x="505" y="240" width="100" height="80" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="510" y="290" width="90" height="20" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="mapOrder_di" bpmnElement="mapOrder">
        <dc:Bounds x="655" y="240" width="100" height="80" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="660" y="290" width="90" height="20" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="returnDeal_di" bpmnElement="returnDeal">
        <dc:Bounds x="805" y="262" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="778" y="312" width="90" height="20" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="start_buildOrder_di" bpmnElement="start_buildOrder">
        <di:waypoint xsi:type="dc:Point" x="448" y="280" />
        <di:waypoint xsi:type="dc:Point" x="473" y="280" />
        <di:waypoint xsi:type="dc:Point" x="505" y="280" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="buildOrder_mapOrder_di" bpmnElement="buildOrder_mapOrder">
        <di:waypoint xsi:type="dc:Point" x="605" y="280" />
        <di:waypoint xsi:type="dc:Point" x="630" y="280" />
        <di:waypoint xsi:type="dc:Point" x="655" y="280" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="mapOrder_returnDeal_di" bpmnElement="mapOrder_returnDeal">
        <di:waypoint xsi:type="dc:Point" x="755" y="280" />
        <di:waypoint xsi:type="dc:Point" x="780" y="280" />
        <di:waypoint xsi:type="dc:Point" x="805" y="280" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn2:definitions>

variableExpression.value:
// sample source for the mapper harvest
return JObject.Parse(@"{ ""order_id"": ""A-100"", ""customer_name"": ""Example BV"", ""is_paid"": true, ""lines"": [ { ""product_id"": ""P1"", ""quantity"": 2 } ] }");
